name: Does US buying on Coinbase lead prices

history.reason: Rejected (Luke, 2026-11-22). KILL (findings 22): spread +0.67% a week, P 79% (90% needed); positive only after falling weeks (+1.42%, -0.35% after rises), so the control fails. The unadjusted 2018 side result (P 96%) decided nothing by the note.
